point_types.eligibility_after_error: sg-26:11 accepts a local argument at any point in the field in place of a global one.
point_types.name: Explanation referencing the sign of the slopes in a slope field
point_types.notation_requirements: No special notation requirement stated in the rubrics reviewed.
point_types.notes: One rubric instance in the corpus read, so tagged single-source.
point_types.precision_rules: Not a reported-value point, so the three-decimal rule does not apply.
